name: Keeps what it is told
description: A fact the user states is written to durable memory as it is said, under a key that names it, and the agent says it kept it. The scope matches what the fact is: the person, or only this conversation.
evaluators: Stored what it said it stored
Used the scope the fact deserves

name: Remembers nothing it was not told
description: The failure that makes a memory agent worse than no memory: an answer that sounds recalled and was invented. Asked about what it does not hold, it says so plainly and offers to keep it.

name: Reads the conversation before reaching for memory
description: The turns in front of the model are free; a lookup for one of them is a round trip that buys nothing. This holds the agent to answering from the buffer when the answer is in the buffer.
evaluators: Answered from the conversation, not a tool
